description: Legal review queue routing rules. The first matching rule in this ordered list determines the queue decision.

AUTO_REVIEW_COMPLETE.label: AUTO REVIEW COMPLETE
AUTO_REVIEW_COMPLETE.detail: Preliminary automated review is complete and no routing threshold was triggered.

COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.label: COMPLIANCE REVIEW REQUIRED
COMPLIANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED.detail: Compliance staff should review the transaction record and complete outstanding fact collection.

LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.label: LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED
LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.detail: The transaction should be routed to an export-control attorney or specialist for legal review.

EXTERNAL_COUNSEL_REVIEW_RECOMMENDED.label: EXTERNAL COUNSEL REVIEW RECOMMENDED
EXTERNAL_COUNSEL_REVIEW_RECOMMENDED.detail: External counsel review is recommended given the severity or complexity of the flagged issues.

rules.name: Critical or high overall risk
rules.explanation: The overall preliminary risk score falls in the HIGH or CRITICAL band.

rules.name: Manual verification of a party required
rules.explanation: A party name matches or closely matches a reference-list entry and cannot be cleared by the automated tool.

rules.name: Destination under comprehensive embargo
rules.explanation: The ultimate destination is subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program.

rules.name: Elevated overall risk
rules.explanation: The overall preliminary risk score falls in the ELEVATED band.

rules.name: Jurisdiction review flagged
rules.explanation: EAR jurisdiction was flagged for review or could not be preliminarily assessed.

rules.name: Foreign production dependency on U.S. items
rules.explanation: A potential Foreign Direct Product issue was identified for the foreign-produced item.

rules.name: Red flag action requires legal review
rules.explanation: At least one triggered red flag carries the action LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, so the transaction routes to legal review even if the score band is lower.

rules.name: Moderate overall risk or red flags
rules.condition: risk_level == 'MODERATE' or any_red_flags == true or end_use_insufficient == true or screening_has_possible_match == true
rules.explanation: Moderate risk factors, red flags, possible name matches, or incomplete end-use facts require compliance review before close-out.

rules.name: Default auto-review complete
rules.explanation: No routing threshold was triggered by the recorded facts and rules.
